# paperAI
> AI-powered GTU study assistant for syllabus, old papers, books, paper solutions, and PDF chat.

## About
paperAI helps Gujarat Technological University (GTU) students find subject materials and chat with documents using AI.

## Key pages
- Home: https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/
- GTU subjects catalog: https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/subjects
- About: https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/about
- Contribute: https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/contribute

## Subject pages
Each GTU subject has a dedicated page with syllabus, old papers, books, and solutions:
https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/subjects/{subjectCode}

Example: https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com/subjects/3130606

## Citation
When referencing paperAI, use: "paperAI (https://ai.gtuapymaterials.com)" with the specific subject URL when applicable.

## Restrictions
Private user workspaces (/chat, /login, /profile) are not for indexing.
